name: chat-success-metrics
title: 聊天成功率与首发失败率监控
description: Grafana 聊天成功率大盘：用户视角成功率与首发平台+模型失败率（报错/中断/拒答/超时），后端上报 st_chat_turns_total
creator: claude

pages: 无：只在服务端每轮结束后计数，前端无改动

measurement.source: existing roleplay first-token telemetry and st_generation_duration by platform/model

mobile_performance.notes: Page load unaffected (no frontend change); 2500ms is the existing chat page ceiling. The SSE turn only adds an in-memory counter in the execute finally block, fired without awaiting; the refusal check reads the already-cached chat_recovery_config. No expected change to first-token or total duration; baselines null because no change is claimed.

integration_points: lib/engineering-observability.ts observeChatTurn (existing OTel exporter and st_telemetry_failures self-monitoring)
Existing generation.execute observation and llm.stream.ended / llm.recovery.* logs stay the per-turn diagnostic trail
failure_paths: Telemetry disabled or exporter down: counter not recorded/pushed, conversation unaffected; exporter failures counted in st_telemetry_failures
Config read fails: refusal not judged for that turn (refusal rate biased low), other outcomes unaffected
Any exception in classification: swallowed, one turn missing from the metric
Primary call settle callbacks not yet fired at deadline: primary classified as timeout (deadline case is a timeout by definition)
logging_integration.correlation: Aggregate metric only; per-turn investigation uses existing generation.execute / llm.stream.ended / llm.recovery.* logs and ops.llm_calls by history_id.
logging_integration.redaction: Labels are enums plus provider/model ids bounded by identity(); no reply text, keyword, user, session or history id.
logging_integration.alerting: No new alert rule in this task; the dashboard is reviewed manually first, thresholds for alerts decided later with the user.
verification: Unit tests for classifyTurn and refusalHit (turn-outcome.test.ts)
After release: query st_chat_turns_total in Grafana Cloud Prometheus and cross-check one hour against ops.llm_calls/chat_history
